@check : {m : ℕ} →
  {Root : Type} →
    [DecidableEq Root] →
      {n : ℕ} →
        ((Fin n → BabyBear) → Root) →
          ConstraintDescriptor BabyBear →
            (ℕ → Fin m → Bool) → Ext6L → Root → Opening n → Transcript m → Except Failure (Receipt Root m)
@check_accepts : ∀ {m : ℕ} {Root Op : Type} [inst : DecidableEq Root] {n : ℕ}
  (S : BindingCommitment Root BabyBear (Fin n) Op) (d : ConstraintDescriptor BabyBear) (encNat : ℕ → Fin m → Bool)
  (gamma : Ext6L) (rt : Root) (op : Opening n) (tr : Transcript m) (rc : Receipt Root m),
  check (↑S).commit d encNat gamma rt op tr = Except.ok rc →
    GateProofAccepts S d encNat gamma tr.challenge rt op rc.terminal (fieldProver tr)
@gateProof_sound_lane : ∀ {m : ℕ} {Root Op : Type} [inst : DecidableEq Root] {n : ℕ}
  (S : BindingCommitment Root BabyBear (Fin n) Op) (d : ConstraintDescriptor BabyBear) (encNat : ℕ → Fin m → Bool)
  (gamma : Ext6L) (w : Fin n → BabyBear) (op : Opening n) (tr : Transcript m) (rc : Receipt Root m),
  check (↑S).commit d encNat gamma ((↑S).commit w) op tr = Except.ok rc →
    ∀ (enc : Fin (descriptorResiduals d (traceOf w)).length ↪ Fin m → Bool),
      (∀ (k : Fin (descriptorResiduals d (traceOf w)).length), enc k = encNat ↑k) →
        ∀ (P : (ℕ → Ext6Q) → ℕ → Ext6Q[X]),
          (∀ i < m, P (chalOf fun q => readExt6 (tr.challenge q)) i = fieldProver tr i) →
            descriptorHolds d (traceOf w) ∨
              ∑ b, gammaResidualTable d (traceOf w) enc (readExt6 gamma) b = 0 ∨
                AdaptiveAcceptsFalse P (mleHonest (gammaResidualTable d (traceOf w) enc (readExt6 gamma))) 0
                  (∑ b, gammaResidualTable d (traceOf w) enc (readExt6 gamma) b) fun q => readExt6 (tr.challenge q)
@residualSum_sparse : ∀ {m N : ℕ} (f : (Fin m → Bool) → Ext6Q) (c : Fin N → Ext6Q) (e : Fin N → Fin m → Bool),
  (∀ (x : Fin m → Ext6Q), mle f x = ∑ k, c k * chiEval (e k) x) →
    ∀ j ≤ m, ∀ (x : Fin m → Ext6Q), residualSum (mle f) x (m - j) = ∑ k, c k * prefixChiEval (e k) x (m - j)
@readPoly1_laneRound : ∀ {m : ℕ} (d : ConstraintDescriptor BabyBear) (wv : ℕ → BabyBear)
  (enc : Fin (descriptorResiduals d wv).length ↪ Fin m → Bool) (encNat : ℕ → Fin m → Bool),
  (∀ (k : Fin (descriptorResiduals d wv).length), enc k = encNat ↑k) →
    ∀ (gamma : Ext6L) (r : Fin m → Ext6L) (i : Fin m),
      readPoly1 (laneRound d wv gamma r encNat i) =
        mleHonest (gammaResidualTable d wv enc (readExt6 gamma)) (chalOf fun q => readExt6 (r q)) ↑i
@receipt_complete : ∀ {m : ℕ} {Root : Type} [inst : DecidableEq Root] {n : ℕ} (commit : (Fin n → BabyBear) → Root)
  (d : ConstraintDescriptor BabyBear) (encNat : ℕ → Fin m → Bool) (gamma : Ext6L) (r : Fin m → Ext6L)
  (w : Fin n → BabyBear) (enc : Fin (descriptorResiduals d (traceOf w)).length ↪ Fin m → Bool),
  (∀ (k : Fin (descriptorResiduals d (traceOf w)).length), enc k = encNat ↑k) →
    descriptorHolds d (traceOf w) →
      check commit d encNat gamma (commit w)
          { word := w, value := laneTerminal gamma r encNat (descriptorResiduals d (traceOf w)) }
          (honestTranscript d (traceOf w) gamma r encNat) =
        Except.ok
          { root := commit w, gamma := gamma, transcript := honestTranscript d (traceOf w) gamma r encNat,
            terminal := laneTerminal gamma r encNat (descriptorResiduals d (traceOf w)) }
@receipt_refuses_tamper : ∀ {m : ℕ} {Root Op : Type} [inst : DecidableEq Root] {n : ℕ}
  (S : BindingCommitment Root BabyBear (Fin n) Op) (d : ConstraintDescriptor BabyBear) (encNat : ℕ → Fin m → Bool)
  (gamma : Ext6L) (w : Fin n → BabyBear) (op : Opening n) (tr : Transcript m),
  op.word ≠ w →
    check (↑S).commit d encNat gamma ((↑S).commit w) op tr = Except.error (Failure.terminal Failure.rootMismatch)
@receipt_refuses_false_claim : ∀ {m : ℕ} {Root : Type} [inst : DecidableEq Root] {n : ℕ}
  (commit : (Fin n → BabyBear) → Root) (d : ConstraintDescriptor BabyBear) (encNat : ℕ → Fin m → Bool) (gamma : Ext6L)
  (r : Fin m → Ext6L) (w : Fin n → BabyBear) (enc : Fin (descriptorResiduals d (traceOf w)).length ↪ Fin m → Bool),
  (∀ (k : Fin (descriptorResiduals d (traceOf w)).length), enc k = encNat ↑k) →
    0 < m →
      ∑ b, gammaResidualTable d (traceOf w) enc (readExt6 gamma) b ≠ 0 →
        check commit d encNat gamma (commit w)
            { word := w, value := laneTerminal gamma r encNat (descriptorResiduals d (traceOf w)) }
            (honestTranscript d (traceOf w) gamma r encNat) =
          Except.error Failure.roundCheck
